title: Zero Gravity Russian Beef Roast
description: A hearty and comforting Russian dish featuring tender beef in a rich gravy, made with macrobiotic-friendly ingredients. This recipe is perfect for a cold winter's night.

ingredients.name: beef roast
ingredients.notes: fatty cut such as chuck or brisket

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef roast with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef roast on all sides until browned, then remove from pot.
Add the sliced onions to the pot and cook until they are softened and lightly browned.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the pot, cooking for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, and browned beef roast to the pot, covering with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and cook for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
Strain the gravy and serve it over the sliced beef and vegetables.
